regions.today: Today will be warm and dry with long spells of sunshine, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 21 to 27 degrees, in a light to moderate southerly breeze.
regions.tonight: A mix of clear spells and well scattered light showers. A mild and muggy night with lowest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees in mostly light variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be largely dry with sunny spells and isolated showers. A warm day with highest temperatures of 23 to 28 degrees in a mainly light southerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Tuesday and Wednesday.
